The context gap between data and meaning

ISA-95, the unified namespace and its governance
Manufacturing integration platform and Microsoft's role

takeaways: ERP owns the business commitment, MES owns the execution record and the PLC and IoT layer own the physical signal, so integration should connect their meaning rather than replace any of them.
Asset identity maps, shared state models, named ownership and versioned data contracts matter more than any single protocol such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST or digital I/O.

A governed unified namespace and a manufacturing integration platform, built with services such as Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, reduce point-to-point coupling while control authority stays with the PLC and approved workflows.
hook: When a bottleneck machine stops, ERP, MES and IoT data can all be correct and still not tell the factory what to do next. This episode is for manufacturing IT, OT and data architects who need to connect existing systems without a replacement program. You will learn how ownership, context, data contracts, a unified namespace and Microsoft building blocks turn machine signals into trusted production decisions.
